title: On Apologising to the whole family
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：apologise　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 apologise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the foreman ① apologised to the whole family at once, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② apologises to the whole family in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ apologise to the whole family at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ apologised to the whole family before — a line in the sheet for May 1963 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Apologising to the whole family at once, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ apologise for the careless word in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Apologise for the careless word at once and never mention it again.

By 1976 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ apologises for the careless word at once every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply  apologised to the whole family again when nobody else would.

To apologise to the whole family, my mother said in 1981, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody apologises to the whole family in the rain again and somebody must apologise to the whole family at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 道歉（一般过去式 apologised to the whole family：1969 年工头头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 道歉（一般现在 apologises to the whole family：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 道歉（不定式 to apologise to the whole family：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 道歉（过去完成时 had apologised to the whole family：1963 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 道歉（动名词 apologising to the whole family 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 辩解（apologise for the careless word：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去辩解为那句失言赔礼）
G. v. 辩解（apologise for the careless word：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 道歉（后段两处：新来的工人照例 apologises for the careless word，而母亲又一次 apologised to the whole family）

items.q: to apologise to the whole family
apologised to the whole family before
apologise for the careless word in the rain
apologise for the careless word at once
apologises for the careless word at once

answers.why: apologise 意为“道歉”，1969 年工头二话不说地道歉向全家人赔不是，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 apologised。
apologise 意为“道歉”，自那以后工头淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 apologises。
apologise 意为“道歉”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯道歉向全家人赔不是”，此处为不定式 to apologise to the whole family。
apologise 意为“道歉”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1976 年之前就有人道歉过，故用过去完成时 had apologised。
apologise 意为“道歉”，工头说“道歉向全家人赔不是这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 apologising to the whole family 作主语。
apologise 意为“辩解”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去辩解为那句失言赔礼”，should ever 之后用原形 apologise for the careless word。
apologise 意为“辩解”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻辩解为那句失言赔礼（apologise for the careless word at once），以后再也不要提起。
apologise 意为“道歉”，新来的工人每个班次都照例辩解为那句失言赔礼，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 apologises。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，工头二话不说地道歉向全家人赔不是；工地里每一个工人都说这是头一回。（apologised to the whole family）
多年以后，工头仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（apologises to the whole family）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯道歉向全家人赔不是这件事本身。（to apologise to the whole family）
早在 1963 年就有人道歉向全家人赔不是，五月那天施工单上的一行字就是证据。（had apologised to the whole family）
工头说过，二话不说地道歉向全家人赔不是这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（apologising to the whole family 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻辩解为那句失言赔礼，以后再也不要提起。（apologise for the careless word，祈使句）
answers: In 1969 the foreman apologised to the whole family at once, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three shifts on, the foreman still apologises to the whole family in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to apologise to the whole family at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had apologised to the whole family long before 1976, and the line in the sheet for May proves it.
Apologising to the whole family at once, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Apologise for the careless word at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 apologise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the foreman apologised to the whole family at once, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman apologises to the whole family in the rain whenever the site asks.
Apologising to the whole family at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever apologise for the careless word in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site apologises for the careless word at once every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother apologised to the whole family again, and the site remembered that half.
